question: What is the meaning of assembly groups in relation to geometric information?
description: Assembly groups in relation to geometric information refer to the organization of elements or components based on their spatial relationships and how they come together to form a larger structure or system. It involves grouping elements or components based on their physical connections and interactions within a building or construction project.
